recipes.name: Shrimp Cocktail
recipes.instructions:
Remove seeds from jalapeno for less heat. Squeeze limes and oranges for juice.
Combine Shrimp and diced veggies. Combine juices and tomato sauce with spices. Mix it all together. 
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Serve Chilled.

recipes.name: Flourless Brownies
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. 
2. Grease an 8x8 baking pan or line it with parchment paper
3. Blend ingredients together until smooth, and optionally, fold in Chocolate chips or chopped walnuts after.
4. Pour batter in the pan, spread evenly. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out of the center clean.

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan Zucchini Boats
recipes.instructions:
1. Halve the zucchini long ways and scoop out the center to make boats.
2. Fill each zucchini with shredded chicken. 
3. Spoon Marinara sauce over chicken.
4. Top with cheeses.
5. Bake at 400 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until bubbly and golden.
